name: AI Video Clipper
description: Automated video clipping and Whisper-based AI transcription system with Go API Gateway, Python worker, Node.js frontend, PostgreSQL database, and Valkey cache.

services.name: webapp
services.description: Node.js Web Frontend with video upload UI & transcript preview

services.name: apigateway
services.description: Go REST API for video job creation, status polling & storage

services.name: aiworker
services.description: Python worker for AI audio extraction & Whisper transcription

services.name: dbpostgres
services.description: PostgreSQL database storing video clips metadata & transcripts

services.name: cachevalkey
services.description: Valkey cache & pub/sub queue for processing jobs
